playbookOutputs: CIPC registration certificate (CoR14.3) for the NPC
SARS income tax reference number issued via CIPC
Note on applying for SARS income tax exemption / PBO status
playbookCommonFailures: Fewer than three directors / incorporators supplied — an NPC needs at least three
All four proposed names rejected or contain special characters
Certified ID older than 3 months or missing for one director
Objectives too vague to qualify as a public benefit or communal purpose in the MOI
Registered address supplied is a PO Box

informationToProvide.label: Certified ID Copy (SA Citizens) or Certified/Apostilled Passport (Foreign Nationals) for Each Incorporator / Director (Min. 3)
alternatives: Certified & apostilled foreign passport + valid permit (foreign nationals only)
informationToProvide.helpText: Minimum 3 directors required for an NPC. SA citizens must submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID front & back or Green Book) within 3 months.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days. Count them — an NPC requires at least three (3) directors.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Residential Address for Each Director (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Utility bill, municipal rates account, lease, or bank statement dated within 3 months for each of the ≥3 directors.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of residential address dated within 3 months per director in the director’s own name.

informationToProvide.label: How Many Directors? (Minimum 3)
informationToProvide.helpText: Minimum 3 directors are required by law for a Non-Profit Company.

informationToProvide.label: Director(s) Residential & Postal Addresses
informationToProvide.helpText: Full residential and postal address with postal code for each director.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Residential and postal street addresses for all directors.

informationToProvide.label: Director(s) Email Address(es)
informationToProvide.helpText: Individual email address for each director (required by CIPC on CoR 14.1A for OTP verification).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Valid email address for each of the >= 3 directors.

informationToProvide.label: Director(s) Cellphone Number(s)
informationToProvide.helpText: Mobile number for each director (required by CIPC for SMS OTP verification).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Valid mobile phone number for each of the >= 3 directors.

informationToProvide.label: NPC Public-Benefit / Communal Objectives & Main Activities
informationToProvide.helpText: Describe the public benefit, cultural, social, or communal object the NPC will pursue (inserted into the MOI Schedule 1 objects clause).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Detailed public benefit or community objectives and activities for the NPC MOI.

informationToProvide.label: Preferred NPC Name 1
informationToProvide.helpText: First-choice name. No special characters. CIPC appends 'NPC'.
informationToProvide.aiHint: First-choice proposed NPC name without special characters.

informationToProvide.label: Preferred NPC Name 2
informationToProvide.aiHint: Second-choice proposed NPC name without special characters.

informationToProvide.label: Preferred NPC Name 3
informationToProvide.aiHint: Third-choice proposed NPC name without special characters.

informationToProvide.label: Preferred NPC Name 4
informationToProvide.aiHint: Fourth-choice proposed NPC name without special characters.

informationToProvide.label: NPC Registered Physical Address
informationToProvide.helpText: Physical street address in South Africa (not a PO Box).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Physical street address and postal code in South Africa for the NPC.

informationToProvide.label: NPC Postal Address
informationToProvide.helpText: Postal address and code for the NPC.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Postal address and postal code for the NPC.

informationToProvide.label: NPC Official Email Address & Contact Number
informationToProvide.helpText: Primary email address and telephone number for the organisation.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Valid email address and contact number for the NPC.

informationToProvide.label: NPC Financial Year-End
informationToProvide.aiHint: Financial year-end month for the NPC (e.g. February).

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect director details, names, addresses and objectives
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certified ID and proof of address for at least three directors, four names, NPC addresses, year-end and objectives received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain plainly that an NPC needs at least three directors and that its income and assets may not be distributed to members — it is for a public benefit or community objective. Ask for four names without special characters. Mention that SARS tax exemption (PBO) is a separate application after registration. Turnaround 1-3 working days; never promise faster.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify director documents and name availability
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All uploads pass; at least three directors with ID and address; names screened
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Extract full names, ID numbers, dates of birth and addresses from the IDs and proofs. ⚠ verify: CIPC requires a minimum of three incorporators AND three directors for an NPC (s13/Schedule 1) — the same three people can be both. Run a CIPC name search on each proposed name.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft registration handoff sheet and MOI object clauses
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Handoff sheet with all CoR14.1 fields, the four names, directors/incorporators and the MOI object clauses drafted from the client's objectives
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Use the CIPC standard NPC MOI (CoR15.1C) unless the client needs a customised MOI (e.g. voting members) — then flag for Kevin. Write the objects clause from the client's description in plain terms and include the non-distribution and dissolution clauses required by Schedule 1, which SARS also needs for PBO approval. Year-end defaults to February.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Reserve name and register NPC on CIPC
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Name reserved and NPC registration submitted with directors, incorporators, addresses, MOI and certified IDs; tracking number saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: CIPC e-Services (or BizPortal) > Register a company > Non-Profit Company. Reserve the four names in order (CoR9.1), then register with the approved name. Capture at least three incorporators and three directors, physical and postal address, year-end and upload certified IDs and the MOI. ⚠ verify current fees (name reservation ~R50, registration with standard MOI ~R125 / customised ~R475). Record the tracking number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for CIPC to issue the certificate
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR14.3 and registered MOI downloadable; income tax number issued
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check the tracking status before following up. If the name is rejected, ask the client for replacements and re-reserve.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver CoR14.3, MOI and tax number
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certificate, MOI and SARS tax number posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain next steps: bank account, SARS eFiling registration and tax representative, and that tax exemption requires a separate PBO application to the SARS Tax Exemption Unit (offer the PBO Registration service) and DSD NPO registration if funders require it (offer NPO Registration).

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
